gui.reason: Music tab Playlist page, default off in all presets. Browse rebuilt libraries and select up to 100 songs. Project save/open and final Build publication integration are supplied in WIRING.md. Audible output is unwitnessed.

input_constraints: Verified USA XBE and validated source AUSB descriptors. Named allocator union must contain code 2048, data 512 and read_only 1024 bytes for nfl2k5_music_playlist.
Selection has at most 100 unique (bank,index) records. Runtime rejects missing descriptors, invalid indices and empty/reversed ranges before binding/enqueueing.

Defaults to 7 menu and 59 jukebox recordings. Outtakes off leaves 54; beds on adds ten. A larger catalogue can hold up to 400 songs per main bank; at most 100 selected records are installed. Zero stops and one repeats.
Rebuild from the supported base for a different installed selection. Publish through the existing image copy transaction. No saved profile, purchase or PA clip mutation.
Actual rebuilt AUSB descriptors and the installed XBE selection must agree before image publication. The executable-only module command does not validate an image.
Choices schema 2 stores the larger browse catalogue separately from the installed selection. Schema 1 imports remain supported. Projects persist a detached, validated music Build settings map.
portme: Apply the protected Build and Studio handoff in WIRING.md and regenerate the cave manifest before release.
Witness every named route, actual stream resume/completion, volume, stereo/surround and PA/show coexistence.
Draft intentionally shares the shuffle instead of scheduled ambience. The original draftambience-to-drafta alias remains unproved and is bypassed.

public_distribution.rule: Only generated patch code, playlist choices and authored assets are portable. No original song, whole bank or disc is included.

runtime.scope: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. All 24 named routing contracts have bounded native transitions with explicit rendering/resource/streaming stubs. This is not audible all-mode certification.

fields.allowed: Music Playlist choices schema 1 or 2, or the default 66-song selection; at most 100 installed records
